subject: SELF and SUPER
notes: kb/Work PB1425 (w1020c). The general format `{ SELF | [ object-class-name-1 OF ] SUPER }` is ONE rule, `selfAndSuper`, and it is now an identifier of the expression tier (`primaryExpression`), besides the object-reference operand rule (INVOKE / inline receiver, SET Format 5, RAISE, the GOBACK / EXIT RAISING phrase). So every sending position spells it: relation and EVALUATE operands (`IF O = SELF`), INVOKE and inline-invocation arguments, SET senders, RAISING SELF - each was a parse error (COBOL0001 / COBOL0901 'SELF is a reserved word'). The binder's one door is OoBinder.OoBindOoIdentifier; SELF binds to an ACTIVE-CLASS temporary filled with the method's object (BoundSelfReference). The object of an object-property identifier (`BAL OF SELF`) is Format 7's identifier-3, owned by FMT-8.4.3.9.2. [editions: the OO facility, 2002+]
